name: Jungle
tagline: The computer thinks on this phone, or one link sits a friend across the river — no account, no server.
description:
Jungle, the Chinese animal game. A green board of dens, traps and two rivers. Eight animals a side, elephant down to rat, each with its rank on the piece. Stronger takes weaker, equals take equals — except the rat, who can take the elephant, and the elephant, who cannot take the rat. The rat swims; the lion and the tiger jump the water. Walk any animal into the other den and you win.

Play the computer on this device. It looks a few moves ahead and never leaves the phone. Pass the device for two people in the same room. Or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. There is no account and no game server. The file is the save.

Tap a piece, then tap where it goes. Legal squares light up.
